text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's broken another bone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I wasn't sure whether I should
tell her or
not... but it's something she'd
hear about sooner
or later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And above all else, knowing that she's
doing her
best to make good on her
promise to Tokai Teio,
there's no way I
could hide it from her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see...
choice_data_list: 『天皇賞（秋）』には、間に合わないと思う
choice_data_list_en: I don't think we'll make it in time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm sorry, but... could we finish
early
today?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I... want to talk to Teio.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you... If you'll excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Yamanin Zephyr leave, I
clench my jaw
in frustration at my own
helplessness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I just wish there was something I could
say to
make her feel better, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to look like you're
caught in a
dry pampero.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio and I... We'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I seem to remember that you were
the one
who helped me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hello, Teio... How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm, okay, I guess? That's how I feel, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me I'll probably be able
to make
a comeback, but also that I
need to give it some
serious thought
before I commit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the repeated injuries have
made my
legs weaker...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Plus, with all the time I've spent away
from racing,
it'll be almost impossible for
me to run like I used
to.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But you know...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel totally different from how I felt before the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, it hit me hard. Like, "Seriously? Another broken bone?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And... I was thinking about how I
wouldn't be able
to keep my promise to
you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But still, that doesn't mean I'm throwing
in the
towel.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You won the Yasuda Kinen, right? So
now you've
only got two more to go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're making progress. And if you're
making
progress, then I want to, too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just watch. I'm gonna make it through
rehab and
get back on my feet.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So just wait a little longer for me,
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (That's right... Teio and I...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Zephyr, you two..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Zephyr, you two..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You can change things by forming a
connection."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I believe it. Struggles and hardships of
any kind,
even fate itself—we can
change them all.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(And because I believe that, I won't give
up.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I'll keep on running, without ever giving
up.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad we talked. Your wind hasn't
stilled in
the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Um... If that means I'm not giving up,
then you're
right! Hehe. There's no way
I'd give up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
As long as we're both running, we can
make as
many promises as we need to
one another.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because the wind... It blows on.
